sentences.text: Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.

Petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ('Cr.P.C.') has been preferred on behalf of the petitioners for quashing of FIR No. 237/2021 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at P.S.: Civil Lines and proceedings emanating therefrom.
Learned APP for the State and learned counsel for respondent No.2 appear on advance notice and accept notice.
Status report / reply be filed before the next date of hearing with an advance copy to learned counsel for the petitioners.
Respondent No.2 be served by all permissible modes on necessary steps being taken by learned counsel for the petitioners, returnable for 15.04.2024.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 13/04/2024 at 01:35:05
Parties are directed to appear in person in Court on the next date of hearing.
